name: International Bachelor Economics and Business Economics
summary: Economics done quantitatively at Erasmus School of Economics, with a business-economics track alongside the general one and the option to move towards econometrics. It is one of the largest English-taught economics cohorts in Europe, and it is also the programme in this catalogue that states its IB entry rule most precisely: named IB mathematics courses at named IB grades, with Applications and Interpretation SL ruled out.
